FEAT-1-STORY-12.title: Location Filtering and FIPS/County Resolution
FEAT-1-STORY-12.description: Implement precise location filtering logic including ZIP-to-county mapping, FIPS resolution, and hierarchical fallback (state → county → city) to ensure geographically relevant provider results.

FEAT-1-STORY-13.title: Embedding Query Generation and Expansion
FEAT-1-STORY-13.description: Generate optimized embedding queries for provider search using dual-model embeddings and optional query expansion to improve recall and semantic matching accuracy.

FEAT-1-STORY-14.title: Search Result Ranking and Confidence Handling
FEAT-1-STORY-14.description: Implement ranking logic for provider results including similarity scoring thresholds, confidence evaluation, and triggering taxonomy fallback when vector confidence is insufficient.
